hypothesis: In E33 the MDN kernel's EM ladder (checkpoints 10..1200) ended at its last checkpoint in 295 of 768 fits and in 149 of 192 at M = 2048, whereas only 18 of 768 network fits hit their cap; the MDN's 2.0-6.2x gap to the spline (E33 P3) is therefore an upper bound that a larger budget may narrow. E41 raises the MDN's ladder to 4800 updates and asks whether the budget was the limit.
design: The frozen e33 driver, part kernels, unmodified, at other settings: arm em_mdn only; cells T0.3_h1_L32, T0.5_iso_L32, T1_iso_L32, T2_iso_L32 (the two refinement cells are left out: a fit there took 2-3.5 h at 1200 updates); M = 2048; seeds 0-7; em_checkpoints = E33's thirteen plus (1800, 2400, 3600, 4800); risk selection as E33. Comparators: E33's em_mixture, em_tilted_spline and em_pair_quartic (hpc_E33k_s*, hpc_E33q_s*) on the same seeds. Four shards of two seeds (e41-s0, s2, s4, s6), 8 workers each, defq.

predeclared_predictions.P1: The budget was binding: paired per seed against E33's MDN at M = 2048, the E41 MDN's seed-mean risk is lower on all four cells, and lower by more than 10% on at least three.
predeclared_predictions.P2: The budget is no longer binding: at most 30% of E41's fits select the last checkpoint (E33: 149/192 = 78% at M = 2048).
predeclared_predictions.P3: The gap persists: MDN / spline (ratio of seed means) is at least 1.5 on every cell, and the MDN's risk is above the spline's in at least 7 of 8 seeds on every cell (E33: 2.0-6.2).
predeclared_predictions.P4: The MDN still beats the mixture: MDN below mixture in at least 7 of 8 seeds on every cell (E33: mdn/mixture 0.23-0.82 at M = 2048).
predeclared_predictions.P5: The MDN does not reach the 5-parameter site energy: MDN above em_pair_quartic in at least 7 of 8 seeds on every cell.

predeclared_analysis: kernels.csv (risk-selected rows) per (cell, seed); paired ratios against E33's frozen risks at M = 2048, same seeds; at_cap from the driver's own flag; read by tools/make_extension_numbers.py (pinned before the data).
provenance_note: NOT a pre-data registration in the strict sense: the design and the thresholds below were written after E33's results at the same cells were read (which is what motivated them), and before any E41/E42 cell ran. The comparators are E33's frozen fits on the same seeds and the same test bundles (checked by hash at read time), not new fits.
resources: cluster, defq, 4 x 8 cpus, 24G, 16 h; a fit takes about 1 h at 1200 updates on a shared node, so up to about 4-5 h at 4800

outcome.P1: FALSIFIED. The extra budget lowered the MDN's seed-mean risk on all four cells but by 0.4-4.5%, on none by more than 10%: T0.3_h1_L32 0.0662 -> 0.0652 (-1.6%), T0.5_iso 0.0474 -> 0.0453 (-4.5%), T1_iso 0.0477 -> 0.0475 (-0.4%), T2_iso 0.0328 -> 0.0323 (-1.5%); per-seed new/old 0.80-1.004. The budget was not what limited the risk.
outcome.P2: CONFIRMED. 5 of 32 fits (15.6%) select the last checkpoint (4800) against 25 of these same 32 at 1200 in E33; per cell 2, 2, 1, 0 of 8; 3 of 32 converged.
outcome.P3: CONFIRMED. MDN / spline (ratio of seed means) 4.33, 3.12, 3.01, 1.86 on the four cells (all >= 1.5), and the MDN is above the spline in at least 7 of 8 seeds on every cell.
outcome.P4: CONFIRMED. The MDN is below the mixture in at least 7 of 8 seeds on every cell (E33's order).
outcome.P5: CONFIRMED. MDN / site energy 9.16, 5.14, 5.95, 4.28; above the site energy in at least 7 of 8 seeds on every cell.
outcome.unregistered: E33's MDN numbers stand: quadrupling the budget changed them by at most 4.5%, so the 'at the cap' flag was not what held the MDN above the spline (gap 1.9-4.3x). The MDN is the one arm for which the cap is not the explanation; E36x's clean-data MDN, by contrast, did improve 3x from 1200 to 2000 updates. A fit takes about 4.1 h (median) at this budget.
